## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(here)
source(here("setup.R"))
```

## Import Data

```{r import}
lfs <- readRDS("data/processed/lfs_analysis.rds")

head(lfs)
```

## Exploratory Analysis

```{r summary}
summary(lfs)
```

## Visualisation

```{r plot}

ggplot(lfs, aes(x = age)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30)
```
